'''Reid:''' {{legend0|#7996e2|50–60%}} | title = [[List of governors of Nevada|Governor]] | before_election = [[Jim Gibbons (American politician)|Jim Gibbons]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Brian Sandoval]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsNV}} The '''2010 Nevada gubernatorial election''' was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010, to elect the [[governor of Nevada]], who would serve a four-year term to begin on January 3, 2011. Despite speculation that incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] governor [[Jim Gibbons (American politician)|Jim Gibbons]] would not run for a second term due to low approval ratings, he ran for re-election.{{cite web |last=Gentry |first=Dana |date=2008-06-04 |title=Consultants: No second term for Gibbons |url=http://www.lasvegassun.com/blogs/final-take/2008/jun/04/no-second-term-gibbons/ |access-date=2008-01-01 |publisher=[[Las Vegas Sun]]}}{{cite web |last=Vogel |first=Ed |date=2008-06-13 |title=GOVERNING NEVADA: Disregard divorce, poll says |url=http://www.reviewjournal.com/news/elections/disregard-divorce-poll-says |access-date=2009-01-01 |publisher=[[Las Vegas Review-Journal]]}}{{Cite news |last=Schwartz |first=David McGrath |date=2009-07-19 |title=With scant crew, Gibbons reelection campaign sets sail |newspaper=[[Las Vegas Sun]] |url=http://www.lasvegassun.com/news/2009/jul/19/scant-crew-gibbons-reelection-campaign-sets-sail/ |access-date=2010-05-05}} He struggled in the polls, and ultimately federal judge and former [[Attorney General of Nevada|attorney general of Nevada]] [[Brian Sandoval]] secured the nomination. Sandoval defeated Democrat [[Rory Reid (politician)|Rory Reid]], son of then-current U.S. Senate Majority Leader [[Harry Reid]], who [[2010 United States Senate election in Nevada|won his fifth term]] in the Senate on the same ballot. ==Republican primary== ===Candidates=== A total of five Republican candidates filed with the [[Secretary of State of Nevada]] and qualified for the ballot.{{cite web | title = 2010 Filed Candidates | publisher = [[Secretary of State of Nevada]] | url = http://www.nvsos.gov/index.aspx?page=337 | access-date = 2010-05-06 }} ====Declared==== * Tony Atwood * [[Jim Gibbons (U.S. politician)|Jim Gibbons]], incumbent governor{{cite news|url=http://www.lasvegassun.com/news/2008/sep/21/rory-reid-lays-ground-run-governor/|title=Rory Reid lays ground for run for governor|publisher=[[Las Vegas Sun]]|first=David|last=McGrath Schwartz|date=2008-09-21|access-date=2009-01-01}} * Stan Lusak, [[perennial candidate]] * [[Mike Montandon]], Mayor of [[North Las Vegas, Nevada|North Las Vegas]]{{cite web|url=http://www.reviewjournal.com/news/montandon-takes-aim-gibbons |title=RUNNING FOR GOVERNOR: Montandon takes aim at Gibbons -
